topic: What challenges arise in maintaining link budget margins for massive beamforming with non-stationary spatial channels in XL-MIMO systems?
consensus_response: Maintaining link budget margins in massive beamforming with non-stationary spatial channels is challenging due to the large array aperture causing signals from widely different directions to overlap, leading to increased interference and reduced link reliability. The beam squint effect occurs with frequency-selective beamforming, further reducing link reliability. Hybrid Analog-Digital Precoding (HADP) can mitigate these effects by optimizing interference rejection and reducing power consumption.
